title: ResourceSelection
description: One `copy`/`move` resource operand. A target without a fragment selects the scheme's default channel; a fragment selects a named channel; headers belong to an HTTP(S) endpoint; lineMarker scopes the selected textual content.

headers.description: Optional HTTP request headers owned by this operand's addressed endpoint; null when omitted.

matcher.description: Optional selection matcher on the source operand; refused by the owner on a destination.
